name: 57732 · Deadwood, SD
findings: ZIP 57732 (Deadwood) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 57732 (Deadwood) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 57732 (Deadwood) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
